versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Launches DeepSeek website in the Brave browser on user request.
- Supports triggers: "open deepseek", "go to deepseek", "launch deepseek", and "/deepseek".
- Runs script to open https://chat.deepseek.com in a new Brave window, ready for user input.
- Confirms action with user after opening.
- Ensures safety by opening only one tab and not altering browser settings.
